repos_data.description: Free open-source downloader for YouTube and 2000+ sites on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Up to 8K HDR 60fps, Dolby audio, MP3, Shorts, playlists, channels, subtitles, SponsorBlock, and just part of a video. Built-in browser: sign in to download private, members-only, and age-restricted videos. No ads. 50 languages.
